newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris Club head hopes for Russia entry accord.
newsitem.headline: Paris Club head hopes for Russia entry accord.

text.p: Paris Club chairman Christian Noyer said on Wednesday that he hoped for an agreement in principle on Russia's entry to the creditor nations grouping by the G7 summit in Denver, next month but technical problems still remained to be resolved.

"The different parties (involved in negotiations) hope to be able to resolve this question, at least on the major principles, before Denver," Noyer told reporters. "All technical questions have not been resolved to date," he said.
He said there would be further negotiations ahead of the Group of Seven rich nations summit.
